ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/creamy) pixels occupy approximately 85% of the visible surface area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing edge and the lower peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central creamy-white contiguous field; thick black continuous banding along the trailing edges; one distinct small circular black focal spot on the lower inner quadrant of the right lobe; extensive yellowish-tan pixel shading across the central lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 45-degree angle and a significant bounding-box depth extending vertically towards the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; jagged pixel-amplitude variations present along the entire trailing edge from tips to notch, characterized by sharp peaks and recessed valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature of the upper trailing edge sweeping toward the distal tips; convex trailing profile near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-intensity (white) raised nodes scattered across the mid-lobe regions; five distinct clusters visible on the left lobe and four on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of fine, low-contrast diagonal and horizontal linear disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, bulbous, textured orange-brown clusters localized at both distal fluke tips (consistent with barnacle colonization); irregular black pigment fragmentation around the median notch apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Pervasive yellowish-tan diatom film covering the primary white pigment across the majority of the ventral surface.
